messages:
jon: Quick check — planning to bump release to v2.4.0 by EOD. Any blockers?

natalie: @jon there's a failing integration test in api-gateway PR #412, needs review.

kevin: I can take a look in ~30m. Failing test reproduces locally in docker; looks like a serializer edge-case. I have a branch kevin/fix-serializer that may fix it.

maria: Docs request — please add changelog bullets for the retry middleware and kv-cache tweak before merge.

jon: Added a TODO to PR #412 to include changelog snippet. Also deciding canary window: 30m @ 10% or 1h @ 25%?

natalie: 30m @10% is fine if infra keeps the timeout bump. Last time 1h helped, but we've improved tail latencies.

infra-bot: deploy-scheduler: Canary env reserved for 30 minutes starting at 2026-03-17T16:30Z (ticket INF-329).

kevin: Pushing PR now, cc @maria for changelog bullets and @natalie for helm/tag after merge.

maria: Drafted changelog lines and pasted into PR description: 
- fix: serializer edge case (PR #412)
- perf: reduced kv-cache misses for short sequences

jon: Also need version bump in package.json and helm chart patch + tag. Who can handle helm?

natalie: I'll update helm values and tag once the PR is green and merged.

jon: Can someone craft a short announcement for #announcements to call out the slight ETA shift? we should be explicit about canary.

maria: Suggested copy: "ETA update: v2.4.0 is now planned for 17:00 PT (30m slip). We will run a 30m 10% canary. Please monitor #incidents for any regressions."

kevin: LGTM. I'm merging now and will ping this thread once canary is live.

release-bot: release-notifier: v2.4.0 candidate created (tag v2.4.0-rc1) by kevin — awaiting canary progress.

jon: Thanks all — ping this thread if anything blocks the canary start. :thumbsup:
